items.name: Diamond Green Diesel Port Arthur SAF upgrade
items.claim: Darling said the Port Arthur SAF project reached final investment decision in early 2023 and began operations in the fourth quarter of 2024, letting about 50% of the 470 million-gallon nameplate capacity be upgraded to SAF.
items.source_excerpt: In early 2023, we announced the final investment decision on a sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) project at our Port Arthur, Texas, facility. The plant began operations in the fourth quarter of 2024, allowing about 50% of its 470 million-gallon annual nameplate capacity to be upgraded to SAF.

items.name: Diamond Green Diesel capacity build-out
items.claim: Diamond Green Diesel has expanded from 160 million gallons of initial annual capacity to 1.2 billion gallons per year since 2013.
items.source_excerpt: From an initial annual production capacity of 160 million gallons, DGD has expanded to 1.2 billion gallons per year since coming online in 2013.

items.name: Diamond Green Diesel SAF supply to Florida (World Fuel and DHL Express)
items.claim: Under the agreement World Fuel Services will deliver over a two-year period approximately 60 million gallons of blended SAF, of which 18 million gallons will be neat SAF produced by Diamond Green Diesel.
items.source_excerpt: World Fuel Services (World Fuel), a World Kinect Company (NYSE: WKC ) will deliver over a two-year period approximately 60 million gallons of blended SAF, of which 18 million gallons will be neat SAF

items.name: Collagen and gelatin combination with Tessenderlo Group (Rousselot plus PB Leiner)
items.claim: Darling signed a definitive agreement to combine Rousselot with Tessenderlo's PB Leiner into a new company expected initially at approximately $1.5 billion annual revenue and about 200,000 metric tons of gelatin and collagen capacity across 22 facilities.
items.source_excerpt: The combination will result in a new company, initially with expected annual revenue of approximately $1.5 billion, and total gelatin and collagen capacity of about 200,000 metric tons across 22 facilities

items.name: Tessenderlo combination ownership and expected close
items.claim: Darling will hold an 85% ownership stake in the combined collagen company, with Tessenderlo Group holding the remaining 15%.
items.source_excerpt: Darling Ingredients will hold a majority, 85% ownership stake and Tessenderlo Group will hold the remaining 15%.
